versions.text: Criterion: Verify that positive locking provisions are incorporated to prevent inadvertent actuation of a mechanism after a safety device such as a fuse or thermal switch is activated and which do not depend on any power source to remain engaged. Standard: Positive locking provisions, once engaged, remain engaged even after a safety device is activated or when a power source is removed. Method of Compliance: Positive locking provisions are verified by inspection of drawings, analysis and on-aircraft test. Reference: JSSG-2009: (Appendix I) I.3.4.9.4.2

Standard: Positive locking provisions are incorporated to prevent inadvertent actuation of a mechanism after a safety device such as a fuse or thermal switch is activated, and which do not depend on any power source to remain engaged. Positive locking provisions, once engaged, remain engaged even after a safety device is activated or when a power source is removed. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review drawings to verify positive locking provisions. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct analysis to verify strength of the positive locking provisions. Demonstration.
    (1) Conduct ground demonstration of the positive locking provisions.
